After-sales support

Committed to customer loyalty, built up through the years with quality vehicles and after-sales support.

Our reputation is our best investment

SC Motors was founded by Christos Spyrou and has specialised in second-hand local and imported vehicles since 2002, with a long list of satisfied customers. Based in Chloraka, the dealer works across Cyprus and looks after car buying or selling requirements wherever you are.

With the internet the dealer reaches car enthusiasts around the world. Replies within 24 hours.
